name: dev
purpose: development suite: use freely to compare and pick; a winner here is re-checked on 'confirm'. Several real floors and variants, all with smoothed walls (Track.with_smooth_walls, '+smooth': no 5 cm grid stairs in contacts or LiDAR), weighted evenly in the pooled table (each map its own row too). The physics is an argument (conditions[].profile): today the code's current default physics ('real-2026-11'), recorded by name in every result; a venue-free default profile is being built separately and replaces it by name. The exam3 layouts on the Korea map were already used by the prior developer to pick checkpoints.
host_ckpt_note: baselines drive through exam_record.py, which needs a plan_steps2 checkpoint of this world for its loop (its plan is computed and never reaches the car; it also sets the LiDAR place 0.12555 m, the same for every November checkpoint)

maps.role: the Korea 2026 venue rebuilt from the bag (bag-scan map, hoses as a 10 cm band, smoothed walls) -- the map every November policy trained on; the 64 exam3 layouts (3 boxes on the empty-track line) were never in training; 2 sessions per layout, different physics draws
held-out variant: duct hoses laid another way (variant 23; training used 0-15), exam3 layouts at the same coordinates (2/192 boxes within 0.15 m of a moved wall)
held-out variant 24, as 23 (2/192 boxes within 0.15 m of a wall)

real/lab12x16: the 12.3 x 16.4 m pre-competition loop (lap 36.1 m, median half-width 0.94 m); 64 layouts x 3 boxes by exam_line_bank.py (seed 20261128) on the smoothed centerline (no driven line exists there), judged passable (min-time line, 0.10 m clearance)

real/lab16x07: the 15.5 x 7.0 m pre-competition hairpin loop (lap 33.3 m, median half-width 0.70 m, the narrowest real floor in the catalogue). NO BOXES: exam_line_bank.py's judge (3 boxes, min-time line 0.10 m clear of box and wall, curvature within the steering limit) passed 2 of 64 layouts after 350 judgements (11-28), so this floor is a box-free generalisation test until a box rule for a 1.4 m lane is agreed
variant: lab12x16 driven the other way round (same floor, every corner mirrored in order); lab12x16's layouts at the same coordinates
maps.scoring_defect: NOT SCOREABLE (11-28): plan_reward.GoalField -- the walls-only distance-to-go every progress / lap number is read from -- builds a 1.01 m 'lap' on real:map12x16+smooth~rev and is NaN on 70 % of the driven decisions, so laps, distance, DNF and streaks cannot be scored on reversed floors until GoalField is fixed (the policy's driving does not read it)

maps.role: variant: lab12x16 with its duct hoses re-laid (Track.with_hoses variant 3: 1-4 m sections moved 8-25 cm, as measured between competition bags); lab12x16's layouts at the same coordinates
variant: lab16x07 the other way round, box-free as lab16x07
maps.scoring_defect: NOT SCOREABLE (11-28): plan_reward.GoalField -- the walls-only distance-to-go every progress / lap number is read from -- builds a 1.01 m 'lap' on real:map12x16+smooth~rev and is NaN on 70 % of the driven decisions, so laps, distance, DNF and streaks cannot be scored on reversed floors until GoalField is fixed (the policy's driving does not read it)

maps.role: CHECK ONLY (not pooled): the main Korea map on its raw 5 cm grid (wall staircases), the same exam3 layouts -- the stairs-vs-smooth line of the bridge table

qual.start: the exam's own spawn (one car, rolling start); laps counted from the first start-line crossing

race.rule: first to M laps (own laps from own start when half a lap apart; one common line = the leading car's otherwise) within the time limit wins; if neither, the one further along wins (ties within 0.5 m = half a win)

starts.half_lap: REPRESENTATIVE (preset roboracer-korea-1v1): opposite sides of the lap, both standing, own laps from own line, no yield duty
starts.side_by_side: auxiliary: RoboRacer 2025 rule grid, same line, 30 cm apart, both standing

opponents.note: a frozen copy of scan31b u500 at 0.70-0.95 of its pace; exam_record's race4 runs the copy on IDEAL execution whatever the condition (a known bias: ~9 % faster than the same pace under MAP), its starts are half a lap or 5 m behind (no side-by-side), half the matches boxed
Follow-the-Gap tuned on the neighbouring map (audit C's opponent)

the env's ForzaETH opponent (simplified spliner on the min-time line with limits 7 / 6.5 / 4, the other car's true state): an opponent slot takes no stack settings, so it cannot be the tuned modular stack (audit C's opponent)
Disparity Extender, korea_2026_competition solo setting; only if it qualifies

race.not_runnable: the October v2 policy as an opponent: opponent_pool._observation_of refuses it in this world's env (it emits 8 action dimensions, the env's cars take 10) -- past checkpoints race only as race4 copies (plan_steps2)

preset.name: roboracer-korea-1v1
preset.yield: none (the caught car has no duty to yield)
preset.win: first to M laps within the time limit, else the further along
preset.note: the representative rule (PM 11-28); side_by_side (30 cm, same line) is auxiliary

race.catch_up: a car catches the other when it first comes within 3 m behind it along the track; after that: contacts, time lost against its own pace before the catch, passes, and the result
race.opponents_rule: 1v1 tables use the self-copy and only the opponents that pass the qualification table (python -m f1sim.compbench qualify); the old opponents are not tuned further (PM 11-28: rebuilding them is a separate task)

ideal.note: the plan driven exactly (kinematic, no delay / servo lag / tyre forces): the training condition, reference only; meaningless for baselines (they publish commands) and for v2 policies

real.note: REPRESENTATIVE: MAP follows the plan, full dynamics, the default randomisation

stress.note: real + pessimistic friction / delay / servo / LiDAR noise

scoring.cluster: box layout (session index mod the bank's layout count) within a map
scoring.same_rule: two drivers are called equal on a metric when the 95 % interval of their paired (same-session) difference contains 0
scoring.dnf: restarted by the env, or < 1 m along the track for 10 s at a stretch, or >= 5 m driven backwards
scoring.hard_contact: a contact onset above the env's contact_severity_min (1.5 m/s closing speed)

place_note: the place, the course and the physics profile are arguments: maps[] names the floor (track) and its box bank, conditions[] the execution and the physics profile file; the world json only supplies the car / box / contact model the November checkpoints were built with
